libraryPreparationPreflight.agent_guidance: Do not attempt to connect to a real Couchbase cluster or bring up Testcontainers' CouchbaseContainer -- no Couchbase Docker image is pinned under tests/tck-build-logic/src/main/resources/allowed-docker-images, so that path isn't available and will stall in CI. Model the suite on the already-merged org.springframework.boot:spring-boot-data-couchbase:4.1.1 tests (tests/src/org.springframework.boot/spring-boot-data-couchbase/4.1.1): exercise CouchbaseMappingContext, MappingCouchbaseConverter, CouchbaseCustomConversions, and @Document/@Field/@Id/@Version-style annotation processing directly with no live connection. For repository-level coverage (CouchbaseRepositoryFactory, derived query methods, N1QL query building), mock the CouchbaseOperations/ReactiveCouchbaseOperations interfaces with Mockito rather than the SDK's concrete classes (e.g. Cluster), which won't mock cleanly with the default mock maker.

libraryPreparationPreflight.summary: Core module behind the already-merged spring-boot-data-couchbase:4.1.1; mapping/conversion/annotation-processing coverage is reachable without a live Couchbase cluster (same boundary that module's tests already proved out), but repository-proxy and query-derivation coverage needs a mocked CouchbaseOperations since no Couchbase Docker image is pinned in this repo.
